corrections.CARD: Removed incorrect inference that all-zero force necessarily means no active contact. Distinguish empty gate from zero force; explicit fallback rho=1 belongs to the constructed example. Multi-finger feedforward is written as a sum with shared joint indices.
corrections.TAMPAgent: Certification is not execution or confirmed holding. Distinguish the 3-action conceptual model from the implementation operator list in Appendix G, PDF p27.
corrections.cuArms: Added finite graph counterexample to fixed-path retiming, with a four-step route and independent lower bound. No optimality or continuous-arm guarantee attributed to cuArms.
corrections.Weight-Space Programming: Added local edit density (1/56 per selected matrix) and relative Frobenius norm changes from immutable public logs, separate from global parameter sparsity.
